forum.title: Hardware required for using motor pilot with custom board
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @Motor\_Power,

Use a USB to TTL Serial Adapter.
forum.content_text:
Hi everyone!

I am developing a custom inverter+control board and need to use motor pilot. Would someone please tell that apart from enabling UART TX and RX through Motor Control Workbench and wiring them, what additional hardware do I need for isolated connection to a PC?

Thanks and Regards
forum.author: Motor_Power

scraped_replies.html:
Hello @Motor_Power,

 Use a USB to TTL Serial Adapter.
scraped_replies.author: GMA

scraped_replies.html:
Hi @GMA,

Thanks for your response, I bought STLINK-V3SET with B-STLINK-ISOL and they are working very well. MCW is a great tool for people like me, who are not very good at writing codes. My drive is working great.

 

Thanks and Regards.
scraped_replies.author: Motor_Power
